_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_playable_duration.py. t_haste_magic is the Haste Magic clock ('until your next end step'), t_light_up is Light Up the Stage's ('until the end of your next turn'), and t_impulse is the this-turn permission both are compared against -- the one the engine had, and the one that is a strictly worse card for either of them.

cards.name: Test Impulse
cards.oracle_text: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.

cards.name: Test Haste Magic
cards.oracle_text: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it until your next end step.

cards.name: Test Light Up
cards.oracle_text: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
